file.enabled.description: Whether to enable the file extension.

file.follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during scanning.

file.scan_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan (0 = current dir only).

file.scan_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for scanning local files.

http.allow_cors.description: Whether to allow Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) requests.

http.enabled.description: Whether to enable the built-in HTTP server for web clients.

http.hostname.description: IP address or hostname for the HTTP server to bind to.

http.max_request_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an HTTP request body.

http.port.description: Port for the HTTP server to listen on.

iris.api_key.description: Optional API key for Iris premium features.

iris.enabled.description: Whether to enable the Iris web UI (requires Spotify).

local.data_dir.description: Directory for local metadata cache (e.g., album art).

local.enabled.description: Whether to enable the local media backend.

local.follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links during local scanning.

local.max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent scanning workers.

local.media_dir.description: Directory containing local music files (same as [file] if shared).

local.scan_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to scan for local media.

logging.log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'console' to log to stdout.

mpd.enabled.description: Whether to enable the MPD (Music Player Daemon) server.

mpd.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous MPD client connections.

mpd.password.description: Password for MPD authentication (leave empty to disable).

spotify.offline.description: Whether to allow offline playback (requires premium subscription).

spotify.password.description: Spotify password (required if Spotify is enabled).

spotify.preferred_language.description: Preferred language for search results (ISO 639-1 code).

spotify.timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for Spotify API calls.

spotify.username.description: Spotify username (required if Spotify is enabled).

spotify.volume_normalization.description: Whether to normalize Spotify volume levels.

stream.buffer_size.description: Size (in bytes) of the streaming buffer.

stream.enabled.description: Whether to enable streaming of network radio and other remote sources.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

fallback_format.description: Format string for missing track metadata. Supports %a (artist), %t (title), %A (album), %n (track number).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MPD server. Can include port (e.g., 'localhost:6600').

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to standard error instead.

min_play_time.description: Minimum play time (in seconds) before a track is eligible for scrobbling. Shorter plays are ignored.

mpd_status_path.description: Optional absolute path to MPD's status file (e.g., /var/lib/mpd/status) for faster song info reads. Leave blank to query MPD directly.

online_status.description: Enable sending 'now playing' status updates in real time (requires scrobbler API support).

password.description: Password for MPD authentication. Leave empty if MPD has no password.

password_hash.description: MD5 hash of your scrobbler account password (not plain text). For Last.fm, hash = md5(username + raw_password).

port.description: Port number for MPD connection. Only used if host does not specify a port.

service.description: Scrobbler service to use. Supported values: 'lastfm' or 'librefm'.

skip_shorter_than.description: Tracks shorter than this (in seconds) are always ignored for scrobbling, overriding min_play_time.

username.description: Username for your Last.fm or Libre.fm account.

auto_play.description: If enabled, automatically starts playback when a track change is detected (if supported by the MPD client).

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait when connecting to MPD before timing out.

max_history_songs.description: Maximum number of songs to retrieve from MPD's playback history.

mpd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Music Player Daemon (MPD) server.

mpd_music_directory.description: Path to MPD's music directory (used only if cover art lookup is needed; optional).

mpd_password.description: Password for MPD authentication (leave blank if no password is required).

mpd_port.description: Port number on which MPD is listening (default: 6600).

mute_on_pause.description: If enabled, mutes audio output when MPD is paused (e.g., to avoid residual noise from players).

show_progress.description: If enabled, shows a progress indicator for the currently playing song in the status line.

addr-flags.description: Comma-separated list of flags for announced addresses

load-plugins.description: Comma-separated list of plugin names to load on startup

log.description: Default logging mechanism to use

notify-flags.description: Comma-separated list of flags controlling address notifications to plugins

path-manager.description: Default path manager plugin to use, overriding plugin priorities

compress_logs.description: If true, compress old log files to save disk space (uses gzip).

daemon_mode.description: If true, run MRTG as a long-lived daemon (polls on schedule). Recommended for high-frequency or many targets. If false, use cron.

debug.description: If true, enable verbose debug logging (very verbose — only for troubleshooting).

default_snmp_authname.description: SNMPv3 authentication username (used only if SNMPv3 is enabled). Leave blank if not using SNMPv3.

default_snmp_authpass.description: SNMPv3 authentication password. Required if SNMPv3 is enabled with auth (noAuthNoPriv or authNoPriv).

default_snmp_authproto.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol: 'md5' or 'sha'. 'sha' is more secure, but older devices may require 'md5'.

default_snmp_community.description: Default SNMP community string used for devices that don’t specify one in their Target line. Avoid 'public' in production for security.

default_snmp_privpass.description: SNMPv3 privacy (encryption) password. Required if using authPriv (authentication + encryption).

default_snmp_privproto.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol: 'des' or 'aes'. 'aes' is preferred for security; 'des' is legacy.

default_snmp_version.description: Default SNMP version (1, 2c, or 3) for targets without explicit version. '2c' is most common for legacy monitoring.

enable_fast_refresh.description: If true, enables fast refresh — avoids reprocessing unchanged data, reducing CPU load.

generate_index.description: If true, generate HTML index pages to summarize monitored targets.

generate_pngs.description: If true, generate PNG graph files in addition to HTML and logs. Set to false for log-only mode.

html_title.description: Title shown on MRTG HTML pages (e.g., 'Network Traffic – Datacenter A').

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds. Standard is 300 (5 minutes). Must match cron/daemon schedule to avoid gaps or double-sampling.

log_errors.description: If true, write errors to stderr (helpful during initial setup or troubleshooting).

log_syslog.description: If true, send log messages to syslog (e.g., for centralized logging).

mrtg_bin.description: Absolute path to the MRTG binary (if installed nonstandard). Usually left as default.

use_24_hour_time.description: If true, use 24-hour format in timestamps; otherwise uses 12-hour (AM/PM).

use_timezone.description: Timezone for timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Avoid 'local' in distributed environments.

work_dir.description: Directory where MRTG stores generated HTML pages, graphs (PNGs), and log files. Must be writable by the MRTG user.

write_pid_file.description: Path to PID file if daemon_mode=true. Required for service management (e.g., stop/start/restart).

audio.enable_denoising.description: Enable or disable post-processing noise reduction — *not* documented in official manpage. Removed default; default should be false.

audio.output_format.description: Output audio format: wav, mp3, or opus — *not* documented in official manpage. Multispeech uses raw PCM via ALSA/DSP; format is typically inferred from device. Retained for compatibility.

audio.sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz; manpage default for tone sampling is 44100 but for generic audio output no fixed sample_rate is documented — this field likely misplaces tone.sampling into audio. Still retained as de facto standard.

backend.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend speech server

backend.port.description: Port number for the backend server API

frontend.dtk_voices.description: Enable DECtalk voice control inline commands; per manpage: default is disabled.

frontend.native_voices.description: Enable native voice control (Emacspeak-style inline commands); per manpage: 'yes' or 'on' enables, 'no' or 'off' disables. Default: yes.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

logging.file.description: Path to the main log file — *not* documented; multispeech logs only via stdout/stderr or syslog when run as module. Retained for compatibility.

logging.max_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain — *not* documented. Removed.

logging.max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation — *not* documented. Removed.

max_buffer_size.description: Maximum buffer size (in bytes) for audio output

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent speech synthesis workers

speech.default_language.description: Default language code (e.g., en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, it, autodetect)

speech.engine.description: Speech synthesis engine to use (e.g., espeak, mbrola, freephone, ru_tts, user); default per manpage is 'espeak'

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) allowed for a synthesis request

bonjour_enabled.description: Publish server via Bonjour/Zeroconf for automatic discovery

enable_registration.description: Allow users to register accounts via client (insecure on public servers)

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (empty = all interfaces)

ice_no_tcp.description: Disable TCP fallback for ICE connectivity (legacy clients only)

log_file_path.description: Path to log file; empty means write to stderr/stdout

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=none, 1=errors, 2=warnings, 3=info, 4=debug

max_bandwidth.description: Total audio bandwidth in bits per second (per-user limit is 1/3 of this)

opus_dtx.description: Enable discontinuous transmission to save bandwidth during silence

pid_file_path.description: Path for PID file (created on startup)

port.description: TCP port for client connections (must be open in firewall)

server_password.description: Password required for clients to connect (leave blank for open server)

silence_threshold.description: Silence detection threshold (0.0–1.0); lower = more sensitive

ssl_ca_path.description: Optional: Path to CA chain file for client certificate validation

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to TLS certificate (required for encrypted connections)

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to TLS private key (must be readable by mumble user)

super_user_password.description: Initial SuperUser password; must be set once during first login

udp_packet_size.description: Max UDP packet size in bytes (0 = auto-detect)

web_cert_path.description: TLS certificate for web interface (if enabled)

web_enable.description: Enable built-in web interface (requires external mumble-website backend)

web_host.description: Interface for web interface binding (127.0.0.1 for localhost only)

web_key_path.description: TLS private key for web interface

web_port.description: Port for web interface (0 = auto-select; typically 8080)

allowRecording.description: Allow clients to use built-in recording feature.

allowhtml.description: Allow HTML in messages, comments, and descriptions.

allowping.description: Respond to UDP ping packets with server stats.

autobanAttempts.description: Connection attempts to trigger global ban (0 = disable).

autobanSuccessfulConnections.description: Count successful connections towards autoban limit.

autobanTime.description: Duration in seconds for global ban.

autobanTimeframe.description: Timeframe in seconds for autoban attempts.

bandwidth.description: Maximum speech bandwidth in bits per second.

bonjour.description: Announce server presence via bonjour service discovery.

channelcountlimit.description: Maximum number of channels per server (0 = unlimited).

channelname.description: Regular expression to validate channel names.

defaultchannel.description: Channel ID to automatically move new users into.

host.description: IP or hostname to bind to (empty = all addresses).

icesecretread.description: Plaintext secret for Ice read access.

icesecretwrite.description: Plaintext secret for Ice write access.

imagemessagelength.description: Maximum text+image message length in characters (0 = unlimited).

kdfiterations.description: Force specific PBKDF2 iterations (>0) or auto (-1).

legacypasswordhash.description: Use legacy password hash mode (1.2.4 and before).

listenersperchannel.description: Allowed listener proxies per channel (-1 = unlimited, 0 = disabled).

listenersperuser.description: Allowed listener proxies per user (-1 = unlimited, 0 = disabled).

logdays.description: Days to retain server logs in DB (0 = forever, -1 = disabled).

logfile.description: Log file path.

messageburst.description: Allowed command messages in short bursts per user.

messagelimit.description: Allowed command messages per second per user.

obfuscate.description: Randomize IP addresses in logs and user status.

opusthreshold.description: Percentage of Opus-supported users to force Opus usage.

pidfile.description: PID file path for daemon mode.

pluginmessageburst.description: Allowed plugin messages in short bursts per user.

pluginmessagelimit.description: Allowed plugin messages per second per user.

port.description: Port to bind TCP and UDP sockets.

rememberchannel.description: Remember and restore the last channel for returning users.

rememberchannelduration.description: Seconds to remember a user's last channel (0 = forever).

sendversion.description: Send server version and OS information to clients.

serverpassword.description: Password required to join the server.

sslCA.description: Path to SSL CA certificate file.

sslDHParams.description: Diffie-Hellman parameters file or named set.

sslKey.description: Path to SSL private key file.

sslPassPhrase.description: Passphrase for encrypted SSL private key.

suggestPositional.description: Alert users to enable positional audio.

textmessagelength.description: Maximum text message length in characters (0 = unlimited).

timeout.description: Seconds before disconnecting uncommunicating clients.

uname.description: OS user to switch to after startup if run as root.

username.description: Regular expression to validate user names.

users.description: Maximum concurrent clients allowed per virtual server.

welcometext.default:
Welcome to this server running Mumble.
Enjoy your stay!
welcometext.description: Welcome message sent to connecting clients.

welcometextfile.description: Path to an external file containing the welcome message.

group.description: Group under which the munin-node daemon runs

user.description: User under which the munin-node daemon runs

contact_always_send.description: Send alerts even when state hasn't changed (e.g., status reminders).

htmldir.description: Directory where Munin generates HTML and static files.

include_dir.description: Directory containing additional configuration files to include.

logdir.description: Directory for Munin logs (node connections, errors).

munin_graph.description: Path to the Munin graph generation script.

munin_html.description: Path to the Munin HTML generator script.

munin_logcheck.description: Path to the Munin log-checking utility.

munin_master.description: Path to the Munin master process executable.

munin_update.description: Path to the Munin data collector script.

vardir.description: Directory for storing RRD databases and cache files.

web_enabled.description: Enable the Munin web interface (HTML + graphs).

admin_autosync.description: Automatically sync ban list and admin files with disk on changes.

admin_enabled.description: Enable built-in admin system for permissions and authentication.

admin_file.description: Path to admin user/permission configuration file.

allow_download.description: Allow clients to download custom models/sounds/maps from this server.

bind.description: Network interface or IP to bind to for game traffic. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

dedicated.description: Run as a dedicated server (no local console or graphics).

fraglimit.description: Match frag limit. 0 disables frag-based ending (use timelimit or roundlimit).

friendlyfire.description: Allow team members to damage each other.

host.description: Server IP address to bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

hostname.description: Server name displayed in the server browser and console.

log_file_enabled.description: Enable logging to a file (see logfile setting).

log_filepath.description: Path to the server log file.

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) before log rotation. 0 disables rotation.

map.description: Default map to load on server startup.

mappath.description: Path (relative to base directory) where custom maps are stored.

maxclients.description: Maximum number of player slots (including spectators).

maxrate.description: Maximum network bandwidth per client (in bytes/sec). Adjust for dialup or high-latency clients.

minplayers.description: Minimum players required to start a match (0 = start anytime).

modelpath.description: Path (relative to base directory) where custom player models are stored.

net_port.description: UDP port for client connections (must match main 'port' unless using a proxy or relay).

port.description: Main UDP port for client connections. Standard for Quake III Arena-compatible servers.

rcon_address.description: IP address to bind RCON to. Use '0.0.0.0' for remote access (not recommended for security).

rcon_password.description: Password for remote console (RCON). Leave blank to disable RCON. Use strong passwords.

rcon_tcp_enabled.description: Enable TCP-based RCON. Use only with TLS/proxy for production.

roundlimit.description: Match round limit. 0 disables round-based ending.

soundpath.description: Path (relative to base directory) for custom sounds.

sv_pausable.description: Allow server pause in dedicated mode (only with -pause flag or RCON).

sv_unlag.description: Enable anti-lag compensation (unlag) for fair play.

sv_unlag_lagtime.description: Maximum time window (in seconds) for unlag prediction. Lower for low-latency networks.

teambalance.description: Automatically balance teams based on player counts.

timelimit.description: Match time limit in minutes. 0 means no time limit (frag-based only).

url.description: Server website URL shown in server browser. Include http(s):// prefix.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the primary CA certificate (optional; often auto-resolved via cacert_dir).

ca_revocation_list_path.description: Path to the CA certificate revocation list (CRL); auto-resolved in most cases.

cacert_dir.description: Directory containing CA certificates for validation.

cleanup_interval_seconds.description: Interval (in seconds) between credential cleanup runs.

credential_lifetime_hours.description: Default credential lifetime in hours (max 168 = 7 days).

enable_gridftp.description: Enable optional GridFTP data channel support.

enforce_renewal.description: Enforce credential renewal within the threshold (deny access if expired).

gridftp_port.description: Base port for GridFTP data connections (if enabled).

identity_cert_path.description: Path to the server's X.509 certificate file.

identity_key_path.description: Path to the server's private key file.

listen_address.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::' for IPv6).

listen_port.description: TCP port number for incoming MyProxy connections.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (empty string disables file logging).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 'debug', 'info', 'notice', 'warning', 'error', or 'critical'.

max_credentials_per_user.description: Maximum number of credentials a single user may store at once.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads for handling concurrent requests.

renewal_threshold_hours.description: Minimum remaining lifetime (in hours) before credential renewal is required.

require_proxy_cert.description: Require clients to present a valid proxy certificate (not just end-entity cert).

working_dir.description: Directory for temporary files and credential storage.

daemon.description: Whether to run as a daemon.

log_file.description: Path to a log file; leave empty to log to syslog instead.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0=error, 1=warn, 2=info, 3=debug.

ssl_ca_path.description: Path to the SSL CA certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS encryption for arbitrator-to-cluster communication.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL client private key file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

vgroup.description: Name of the group (group) — must match the Galera cluster name.

basedir.description: Base directory where MariaDB is installed.

bind_address.description: IP address MariaDB binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to accept connections from any interface (not recommended without firewall).

character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

collation_server.description: Default collation for new databases and tables. Must match character_set_server.

datadir.description: Directory where database files are stored.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of the memory buffer InnoDB uses to cache data and indexes. Recommend ~70% of available RAM on dedicated servers.

innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in its own .ibd file. Required for tablespace operations and compression.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls InnoDB durability vs performance trade-off. 1 = safest (sync on each commit), 2 = faster (sync once/sec), 0 = fastest (risk of data loss).

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group. Larger values improve performance but increase crash recovery time.

log_bin_enabled.description: Enable binary logging. Required for replication and point-in-time recovery.

log_bin_trust_function_creators.description: If disabled (recommended), prevents users without SUPER p

long_query_time.description: Queries taking longer than this many seconds will be logged as slow queries.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or any generated/intermediate BLOB.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

port.description: TCP/IP port number for client connections.

query_cache_size.description: Total memory allocated for query cache. Set to 0 to disable. Ignored if query_cache_type is OFF.

query_cache_type.description: Query cache behavior: 0=OFF, 1=ON (cache all except SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE), 2=DEMAND (cache only SELECT SQL_CACHE). Deprecated in MariaDB 10.1+.

server_id.description: Unique server identifier for replication. Must be unique across all servers in the replication topology.

slow_query_log_enabled.description: Enable logging of slow queries to file (or to table if log_output includes TABLE).

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file (only used if slow_query_log is enabled).

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep cached for reuse. Helps reduce thread creation overhead on high-concurrency workloads.

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files created by MariaDB (e.g., during sorting or temp tables).

assume_yes.description: Automatically assume yes to all interactive prompts.

auto_remove.description: Automatically remove unnecessary packages after upgrades.

auto_update.description: Automatically update the package list before running upgrade.

filesize_binary.description: Use MiB for file sizes instead of MB.

full_upgrade.description: Make full-upgrade the default upgrade behavior.

simple_summary.description: Enable a more condensed transaction summary.

transfer_speed_bits.description: Show transfer speed in MegaBit instead of MegaByte.

update_show_packages.description: List upgradable packages automatically after update.

host.description: The host to bind the NATS server to.

port.description: The port to listen on for client connections.

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).

enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

--color.description: Set the color scheme applied to the interface.

--confirm-delete.description: Require a confirmation prompt before deleting files or directories.

--confirm-quit.description: Require a confirmation prompt before exiting the application.

--disk-usage.description: Select whether to display actual disk usage or apparent file sizes.

--enable-delete.description: Enable or disable the built-in file/directory deletion feature.

--enable-natsort.description: Enable or disable natural sorting when ordering by filename.

--enable-refresh.description: Enable or disable directory content refreshing from the file browser.

--enable-shell.description: Enable or disable spawning a shell from within the file browser.

--exclude.description: Exclude files matching the specified pattern from usage statistics.

--exclude-firmlinks.description: Exclude or follow MacOS firmlinks during scanning.

--exclude-from.description: Exclude files matching any pattern listed in the specified file.

--extended.description: Enable or disable extended information mode showing ownership, permissions, and mtime.

--follow-symlinks.description: Follow symbolic links and count the size of their target files.

--graph-style.description: Define the character style used to draw the relative size bar.

--group-directories-first.description: Sort directories before files in the display list.

allow_for_physical_item_deletion.description: If set to yes, allows physically deleting files/directories from disk.

alternative_header_first_line_format.description: Now playing song format for the first line in alternative UI header.

alternative_ui_separator_color.description: Color of separators used in alternative user interface.

ask_before_clearing_playlists.description: If enabled, user will be asked before clearing the playlist.

ask_for_locked_screen_width_part.description: If enabled, ncmpcpp will ask for locked screen width percentage.

autocenter_mode.description: Default state for autocenter mode at start.

block_search_constraints_change_if_items.description: If enabled, search fields are blocked after successful search.

browser_sort_format.description: Format to use for sorting songs in browser.

centered_cursor.description: If enabled, highlighted list position will always be centered.

clock_display_seconds.description: If enabled, clock will display time in hh:mm:ss format.

color1.description: One of colors used in Song info, Tiny tag editor and Search engine.

color2.description: One of colors used in Song info, Tiny tag editor and Search engine.

colors_enabled.description: Enable or disable colors in the interface.

connected_message_on_startup.description: Show the 'Connected to ...' message on startup.

current_item_inactive_column_prefix.description: Prefix for currently selected item in the inactive column.

current_item_inactive_column_suffix.description: Suffix for currently selected item in the inactive column.

cyclic_scrolling.description: If enabled, cyclic scrolling is used in lists.

data_fetching_delay.description: Adds 250ms delay when fetching data from MPD to limit traffic.

default_find_mode.description: If wrapped, searching loops back to start/end.

default_place_to_search_in.description: Search engine will search in playlist or music database.

default_tag_editor_pattern.description: Default pattern used by Tag editor's parser.

discard_colors_if_item_is_selected.description: Discard custom colors of tags if item is selected.

display_bitrate.description: If enabled, bitrate of currently playing song will be displayed.

display_remaining_time.description: If enabled, remaining time is displayed instead of elapsed time.

display_volume_level.description: If enabled, volume level will be displayed in statusbar.

spooldir.description: Directory where user mailboxes (mbox or maildir) are stored

tls_certfile.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for secure connections

tls_keyfile.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format)

top_enabled.description: Enable the POP3 TOP command (allows partial message retrieval)

uidl_enabled.description: Enable the POP3 UIDL command (unique message identifiers)

block_host.description: Automatically block detected attackers (by adding to /etc/hosts.deny or firewall rules).

block_time.description: Duration (seconds) to block a host before unblocking (set 0 for permanent block).

detection_window.description: Time window (seconds) during which connection attempts are counted for scan detection.

ignore_icmp.description: Disable detection for ICMP traffic (set to true to ignore ICMP packets).

ignore_udp.description: Disable detection for UDP traffic (set to true to ignore UDP packets).

kill_cmd.description: Custom command to run when blocking a host (e.g., for alerting or logging).

max_connections.description: Maximum connections allowed per host per detection window (0 = unlimited).

scan_mode.description: Which traffic to monitor: 'tcp' (TCP SYN, FIN, etc.), 'udp' (UDP), or 'both'.

stealth_scan_threshold.description: Number of connection attempts per host within the detection window to trigger an alert.

strict_tcp_scan.description: Enable detection of non-standard TCP scans (XMAS, NULL, FIN, SYN-ACK, etc.).

strict_udp_scan.description: Enable detection of suspicious UDP patterns (e.g., fragmented packets, unusual ports).

tcp_mode.description: TCP scanning mode: 'tcp' (standard), 'stcp' (stealth), 'atcp' (aggressive stealth), or empty to disable.

udp_mode.description: UDP scanning mode: 'udp', 'sudp', 'audp', or empty to disable.

autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor.description: Fraction of table size added to analyze threshold.

autovacuum_analyze_threshold.description: Minimum tuple updates before analyze is triggered.

autovacuum_max_workers.description: Maximum number of autovacuum worker processes.

autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor.description: Fraction of table size added to vacuum threshold.

autovacuum_vacuum_threshold.description: Minimum tuple updates before vacuum is triggered.

checkpoint_completion_target.description: Fraction of checkpoint interval over which WAL writes are spread (0.0–1.0). Higher = smoother I/O.

data_directory.description: Absolute path to the database cluster data directory.

hba_file.description: Absolute path to the client authentication config file (pg_hba.conf).

ident_file.description: Absolute path to the user name mapping file (pg_ident.conf).

listen_addresses.description: Which IP addresses/ hostnames the server listens on. Use '*' for all interfaces.

log_directory.description: Directory for log files (relative to data_directory or absolute path).

log_filename.description: Pattern for log filenames (supports strftime placeholders).

log_line_prefix.description: Prefix for each log line. Format codes: %m=timestamp, %p=pid, %u=user, %d=db, etc.

log_min_duration_statement.description: Log statements slower than this (ms). -1 disables. Use 1000 to log queries >1s.

log_rotation_age.description: Max age of a log file before rotation (e.g., '1d', '24h').

log_rotation_size.description: Max size of a log file (in bytes) before rotation. 0 = unlimited.

logging_collector.description: Enable logging to files (instead of stderr).

maintenance_work_mem.description: Maximum memory for maintenance operations (VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, etc.).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

max_wal_size.description: Maximum size of WAL files before a forced checkpoint.

min_wal_size.description: Minimum size of WAL files to retain after cleanup.

port.description: The TCP port the PostgreSQL server listens on.

shared_buffers.description: Amount of memory dedicated to caching data (e.g., '256MB', '1GB'). Recommended ~25% of total RAM for dedicated DB servers.

wal_buffers.description: Shared memory for WAL writes. Set to -1 for automatic tuning.

wal_level.description: WAL level: 'minimal' (no replicas), 'replica' (basic replication), or 'logical' (logical replication & logical decoding).

work_mem.description: Memory per operation (e.g., sort, hash) before spilling to disk. Higher values speed complex queries but multiply with connections.

db_engine.description: Database engine: 'sqlite', 'mysql', or 'postgres'. SQLite is standard for most Postfix setups.

db_path.description: Path to the database file used for storing greylisting records. SQLite is used by default.

greylist_max_age.description: Maximum seconds after which greylisting records expire (i.e., after how long a sender must re-greylist).

greylist_seconds.description: Minimum seconds to wait before accepting mail from a new sender. Typical value: 300 (5 minutes).

listen_address.description: IP address on which postgrey listens for incoming SMTP connections from Postfix. Usually localhost.

listen_port.description: TCP port number for postgrey to bind to. Default Postfix port for greylisting is 10023.

log_file.description: Path to log file when syslog is disabled. Ignored if syslog is enabled.

loglevel.description: Verbosity level: 0 (quiet), 1 (normal), 2 (verbose). Set higher if troubleshooting.

postgrey_text.description: Custom greylist rejection message text. Used only if set (non-empty).

run_as_group.description: Optional system group to run the daemon under. If empty, uses the primary group of `run_as_user`.

run_as_user.description: System user account to run the postgrey daemon under. Should have read/write access to the database file.

syslog.description: If true, log to system syslog. If false, log to file instead.

whitelist_clients_delay.description: Time (in seconds) before greylisting is skipped for whitelisted clients. Set to 0 to skip greylisting entirely for them.

whitelist_postfix_smtpd.description: If true, skip greylisting for mail submitted via postfix local smtpd.

whitelist_recipients_delay.description: Time (in seconds) before greylisting is skipped for whitelisted recipients. Set to 0 to disable greylisting for them.

chroot_dir.description: Chroot directory for security hardening. Standard is '/var/lib/postsrsd'.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging (true) or quiet operation (false). Not directly configurable here; use extra_daemon_options instead.

listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the postsrsd socket to. Use '127.0.0.1' for local Postfix; '0.0.0.0' only if remote.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed. Not configurable in this init script; limited by kernel/daemon defaults.

srs_domain.description: Domain used for SRS rewriting (e.g., the domain of your mail server). Must be a valid, verified domain.

srs_forward_port.description: TCP port on which postsrsd listens for Postfix lookup queries. Standard is 10001.

srs_hashlength.description: Length of the hash suffix appended to rewritten addresses. Standard is 4.

srs_hashmin.description: Minimum hash length for validation. Usually same as hashlength.

srs_reverse_port.description: TCP port used for reverse SRS lookups (bounce handling). Usually 10002.

srs_secret.description: Path to file containing the secret key for signing/verifying SRS addresses. Must be ≥16 chars, randomly generated, and kept secret.

srs_separator.description: Separator character used in SRS addresses. Standard is '==' (two equals signs).

debug.description: Enable debug mode and verbose logging output

dsn.description: Database connection string (DSN) for the PoWA repository

auto_detect.description: Enable automatic detection and monitoring of newly connected battery devices

critical_threshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which a 'critical' alert is triggered

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging; choose from debug, info, warning, error

notification_script.description: Path to script invoked on battery status changes (receives device name, status, and % capacity)

notification_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the notification script before timing out

pid_file.description: Path to store the daemon's PID file

smtp_password.description: SMTP password (leave blank if no authentication)

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname (used only if email alerts enabled)

smtp_use_tls.description: Use TLS encryption for SMTP connection

smtp_user.description: SMTP username (leave blank for unauthenticated SMTP)

tick_interval.description: Number of seconds between battery status polls

warning_threshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which a 'warning' alert is triggered

log_ppp_connect_errors_path.description: Path to the ppp connection errors log file.

log_rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

ac_name.description: Desired access concentrator name to initiate sessions with.

discover_exit.description: Perform discovery, print session information, and exit.

discovery.description: Send PADI packet and print access concentrator names.

dump_file.description: File path to dump every packet to (debug only).

frame_types.description: Hexadecimal frame types for discovery and session (colon-separated).

host_uniq.description: Use standard Host-Uniq tag derived from the process PID.

host_uniq_value.description: Custom value to set for the Host-Uniq tag.

interface.description: The Ethernet interface to use for the PPPoE connection.

kill_session.description: Terminate an existing session via PADT and exit.

mss.description: TCP maximum segment size to clamp.

no_discovery.description: Do not open a discovery socket.

pid_file.description: File path to write the pppoe process ID.

service_name.description: Desired service name to initiate sessions with.

session.description: Skip discovery phase; specify session ID and peer MAC directly.

source_mac.description: Source Ethernet MAC address for packets (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

sync.description: Use synchronous PPP encapsulation instead of asynchronous.

timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before pppoe exits.

history_dir.description: Directory where preload stores access history (patterns of file reads) for learning.

max_processes.description: Maximum number of processes the daemon will track simultaneously. Larger values increase memory usage.

passive.description: Whether to reactively read ahead *only* when a process actually opens a file.

preload_iosched.description: I/O scheduling class to use for preload (e.g., '--iosched idle').

proactive.description: Whether to proactively load files for frequently-used processes *before* they are opened (improves responsiveness, but may increase disk usage).

profile_dir.description: Directory where preload stores readahead profiles for known files and applications.

readahead_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to read ahead per I/O request. Set to 0 to use the kernel's default value.

scan_interval.description: How often (in seconds) the daemon scans the system for new processes and updates its database.

foreground.description: Default text and data output color.

graph-solid.description: Whether graph outputs should be rendered as solid fills rather than lines.

grid-foreground.description: Color used for graph grid lines.

grid-min.description: Minimum number of horizontal grid lines to draw on graph outputs.

label-font.description: X11 font specification for graph output labels.

label-font-pango.description: Pango font specification for graph output labels.

label-foreground.description: Text color for graph output labels.

label-position.description: Position of the label relative to the data output.

options.description: Module-specific parameters (e.g., network interfaces, interrupt limits, or log file paths).

order.description: Space-separated list of outputs to display on startup (format: <module>.<output>[-g|-t|-b]).

path.description: Directory path where the ProcMeter3 module library is located.

run.description: Shell command to execute when the Run menu option is selected for an output.

text-font.description: X11 font specification for text-mode outputs.

text-font-pango.description: Pango font specification for text-mode outputs.

[[columns]].description: Defines which columns are displayed and their rendering order.

display.color_mode.description: Controls when color output is enabled or disabled.

display.cut_to_pager.description: Truncate output lines to fit the pager width.

display.cut_to_pipe.description: Truncate output lines to fit a pipe output.

display.cut_to_terminal.description: Truncate output lines to fit the terminal width.

display.show_self.description: Include the procs process itself in the output.

display.show_thread_in_tree.description: Show threads within the process dependency tree.

docker.path.description: UNIX socket path to the Docker daemon for container info.

pager.mode.description: Pager mode (Auto, less, more, or built-in) for large outputs.

search.logic.description: Logical operation for combining search keywords.

search.nonnumeric_search.description: Matching behavior for non-numeric search keywords.

search.numeric_search.description: Matching behavior for numeric search keywords.

sort.order.description: Sort order for the selected sort column.

style.by_percentage.color_000.description: ANSI color theme for 0% usage bars.

style.by_percentage.color_025.description: ANSI color theme for 25% usage bars.

style.by_percentage.color_050.description: ANSI color theme for 50% usage bars.

style.by_percentage.color_075.description: ANSI color theme for 75% usage bars.

style.by_percentage.color_100.description: ANSI color theme for 100% usage bars.

style.by_state.color_d.description: ANSI color theme for process state D.

style.by_state.color_k.description: ANSI color theme for process state K.

style.by_state.color_p.description: ANSI color theme for process state P.

style.by_state.color_r.description: ANSI color theme for process state R.

style.by_state.color_s.description: ANSI color theme for process state S.

style.by_state.color_t.description: ANSI color theme for process state T.

style.by_state.color_w.description: ANSI color theme for process state W.

style.by_state.color_x.description: ANSI color theme for process state X.

style.by_state.color_z.description: ANSI color theme for process state Z.

style.by_unit.color_g.description: ANSI color theme for GB memory units.

style.by_unit.color_k.description: ANSI color theme for KB memory units.

style.by_unit.color_m.description: ANSI color theme for MB memory units.

style.by_unit.color_p.description: ANSI color theme for PB memory units.

style.by_unit.color_t.description: ANSI color theme for TB memory units.

style.by_unit.color_x.description: ANSI color theme for XB memory units.

style.header.description: ANSI color theme for column headers.

style.tree.description: ANSI color theme for tree view lines.

style.unit.description: ANSI color theme for unit labels.

global_listen_addr.description: IP address the proxy listens on. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

global_listen_port.description: Port the proxy listens on for incoming SMTP (typically 25, 587, or 465).

global_log_file.description: Path to the main log file. Leave empty to log to stdout/stderr.

global_log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

global_pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the ProxSMTP daemon.

global_run_dir.description: Directory where runtime files (e.g., PID files) are stored.

tls_ca_file.description: Optional path to CA bundle for client certificate verification.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the server TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for inbound connections (STARTTLS or implicit TLS depending on port).

tls_key_path.description: Path to the server TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

chain_len.description: Number of proxies to chain when using random_chain mode.

dynamic_chain.description: Enable dynamic proxy chaining, skipping dead proxies in the chain.

proxy_dns.description: Proxy DNS requests to prevent DNS leaks.

quiet_mode.description: Suppress all library output and console messages.

random_chain.description: Enable random proxy chaining, selecting proxies randomly from the list.

strict_chain.description: Enable strict proxy chaining, requiring all proxies to be online or returning an error.

ProxyList.description: List of proxies to use (format: type ip port [user pass]).

chain_len.description: Length of proxy chain for round-robin or random chaining.

dnat.description: DNAT mapping rules to redirect connections through proxies.

dynamic_chain.description: Chain proxies dynamically, skipping dead proxies.

localnet.description: IP ranges or subnets to exclude from proxying.

proxy_dns.description: Proxy DNS requests via an internal threaded DNS resolver.

proxy_dns_daemon.description: Address and port for the proxychains4-daemon DNS server.

proxy_dns_old.description: Proxy DNS requests using the old proxyresolv script.

quiet_mode.description: Suppress all output from the library.

remote_dns_subnet.description: Class A subnet number for internal remote DNS mapping.

strict_chain.description: Chain proxies strictly in order, all must be online.

log_pressures.description: Controls whether pressure values are logged.

threshold.default: cpu some avg10 50.00, memory some avg10 10.00, io full avg10 15.00
threshold.description: Defines pressure thresholds to trigger notifications. Format: <resource> <scope> <metric> <value>.

allow_multiple_sources.description: Allow multiple timing sources. Useful for redundancy or grandmaster failover.

announce_interval.description: Interval between Announce messages (seconds). Typical: 1 or 2.

clock_identity_source.description: How clock identity is generated: 'hw' (MAC-based, recommended) or 'sw' (random).

delay_asymmetry.description: One-way path asymmetry (nanoseconds). Used only with peer-to-peer delay mechanism.

delay_req_interval.description: Minimum interval between Delay_Req messages (seconds). Set to 1 or 2.

domain_number.description: PTP domain number (0–65535). All devices in the same time domain must match.

hw_timestamping.description: Enable hardware timestamping for sub-microsecond precision (recommended).

initial_frequency.description: Initial frequency correction (parts-per-billion) applied at startup.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity (0=fatal, 7=debug). Set to 2 or 3 for production; 4+ for debugging.

log_sync_messages.description: Log every SYNC message for deep diagnostics (can be very verbose).

primary_domain.description: Fallback domain number when domain mismatch occurs.

ptp_device.description: Explicit PTP device (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'). Leave empty to auto-detect.

slave_only.description: If true, this device behaves only as a slave (ordinary clock). Set false for boundary clocks.

sync_interval.description: Interval between Sync messages (seconds). Use -1 for 'as fast as hardware allows'.

transport_mode.description: Transport mode. Use 'udp' for most deployments; 'ieee_1588' for legacy L2-only setups.

PTPD_OPTS.description: Additional command-line options to pass to ptpd (e.g., --interface eth0 --domain 0).

enabled.description: Start the PTP daemon on service startup.

enforce_src.description: If true, only accept ICMP packets from IPs listed in allowed_src_nets.

listen_interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Use 'auto' to let ptunnel auto-detect.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr.

max_idle_time.description: Maximum inactivity (in seconds) before a tunnel is forcibly closed.

max_tunnels.description: Maximum number of concurrent tunnels (TCP connections) allowed.

password.description: Password for securing the tunnel. Must be identical on both client and server.

ping_delay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) between consecutive ping packets. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more reliable through firewalls.

ping_dest_port.description: ICMP destination port used in the ICMP tunnel (must match between client and server). 0 = echo request.

ping_size.description: Size (in bytes) of ICMP payload. Larger sizes may improve throughput but increase fragmentation.

ping_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) value for outgoing ICMP packets. 0 = use system default.

remote_dst.description: Target remote IP address for the ICMP tunnel (required on the receiving end).

run_daemon.description: Set to "true" to enable the ptunnel daemon (must be set to 'true' to start the service).

tunnel_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which an idle tunnel is closed.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging? If true, logs at normal level. Use 0 or 1 explicitly for fine control.

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).

enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

delivery.recipient.description: Message recipient. If empty, defaults to the username associated with the effective user ID.

log_level.description: Root logging level: 'trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', or 'fatal'

plugin_dir.description: Directory where package plugins are copied upon installation.

script_dir.description: Directory where package scripts are copied upon installation.

state_dir.description: Directory where source repositories are cloned, packages are installed, and state information is maintained.

zeek.description: Default package source repository git URL.

zeek_dist.description: Directory containing Zeek distribution source code (required for building non-pre-built plugins).

bandwidth.description: Set the send rate in bits/second (supports suffixes G, M, and K)

blacklist-file.description: File of subnets to exclude, in CIDR notation, one-per line

cooldown-time.description: How long to continue receiving after sending has completed

dry-run.description: Print out each packet to stdout instead of sending it

gateway-mac.description: Gateway MAC address to send packets to

interface.description: Network interface to use

max-results.description: Exit after receiving this many results

max-runtime.description: Cap the length of time for sending packets

max-targets.description: Cap the number of targets to probe (number or percentage)

output-args.description: Arguments to pass to output module

output-fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to output

output-file.description: When using an output module that uses a file, write results to this file

output-filter.description: Specify an output filter over the fields defined by the probe module

probe-args.description: Arguments to pass to probe module

probes.description: Number of probes to send to each IP

quiet.description: Do not print status updates once per second

rate.description: Set the send rate in packets/sec

seed.description: Seed used to select address permutation

shards.description: Split the scan up into N shards/partitions among different instances of zmap

source-ip.description: Source address(es) to send packets from

source-port.description: Source port(s) to send packets from

summary.description: Print configuration and summary of results at the end of the scan

target-port.description: TCP or UDP port number to scan

config_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostic output; set to 1 to make config errors fatal, 0 to ignore them.

min_proto_dtls.description: Minimum DTLS protocol version (e.g., '1.2') for system_default.

min_proto_tls.description: Minimum TLS protocol version (e.g., '1.2') for system_default.

oid_section.description: Name of section containing custom OIDs (e.g., 'oids').

openssl_conf.description: Name of the initialization section containing module selectors.

rng_properties.description: Property query string for RNG and underlying algorithms.

rng_seed_properties.description: Property query for the randomness source.

rng_type.description: Random bit generator type: CTR-DRBG, HASH-DRBG, or HMAC-DRBG.

assume-ipv6ll-only.description: Specify devices for which to generate a connection based only on IPv6 link-local address.

audit.description: Whether to deliver audit records to auditd.

auth-polkit.description: Whether to use PolicyKit for authorization.

autoconnect-retries-default.description: Number of times to auto-try connection activation before switching.

carrier-wait-timeout.description: Timeout for carrier detection in ms (default 6000).

configure-and-quit.description: Whether to quit after configuring network (initrd only); 'true' is unsupported since 1.36.

debug.description: Comma-separated list of debugging options.

domains.description: Log domains to filter messages by, with optional per-domain overrides.

enable.description: Conditional enabling of config file (supports version, env, except).

enabled.description: Whether connectivity checking is enabled.

ethernet.mtu.description: MTU for Ethernet (0 = do not reconfigure unless required).

hostname.description: Deprecated; no effect.

hostname.from-dhcp.description: Whether to use hostname from DHCP.

hostname.from-dns-lookup.description: Whether to use hostname from reverse DNS lookup.

hostname.only-from-default.description: Whether to update hostname only from default route connection.

ignore-carrier.description: Whether to ignore carrier on device.

infiniband.mtu.description: MTU for InfiniBand (0 = do not reconfigure unless required).

ip-tunnel.mtu.description: MTU for IP tunnels (0 = do not reconfigure unless required).

ipv4.required-timeout.description: Timeout for IPv4 to be considered required.

ipv4.route-table.description: IPv4 route table (0 = main only, but note special semantics).

ipv6.required-timeout.description: Timeout for IPv6 to be considered required.

iwd-config-path.description: Path for IWD config directory or 'auto', empty string disables conversion.

keep-configuration.description: Whether to preserve pre-existing configuration on startup.

managed.description: Whether a device is managed by NetworkManager.

migrate-ifcfg-rh.description: Whether to automatically convert ifcfg-rh profiles to keyfile.

no-auto-default.description: Specify devices for which to skip default wired connection creation.

plugins.description: Lists system settings plugin names for reading/writing connection profiles.

rename.description: Whether to rename keyfiles when profile name changes.

servers.description: DNS servers for a specific domain.

sriov-num-vfs.description: Number of SR-IOV VFs to enable.

sriov.autoprobe-drivers.description: Whether to autoprobe drivers for SR-IOV VFs.

systemd-resolved.description: Whether to send DNS config to systemd-resolved.

unmanaged-devices.description: Devices to ignore entirely (cannot be overridden at runtime).

uri.description: URI for connectivity check (blank disables checking).

wifi.generate-mac-address-mask.description: Mask for generated Wi-Fi MAC address.

wifi.iwd.autoconnect.description: Whether to allow IWD autoconnect on device.

wifi.mtu.description: MTU for Wi-Fi (0 = do not reconfigure unless required).

wifi.scan-generate-mac-address-mask.description: Mask for generated MAC during scan.

wifi.scan-rand-mac-address.description: Whether to randomize MAC during Wi-Fi scan.

allow-failsafe.description: Enables failsafe X session mode (x-terminal-emulator only, no window manager).

allow-user-resources.description: Allows merging of user's .Xresources with default X resources at login.

allow-user-xsession.description: Allows users to run a personal .xsession script as their X session startup.

use-session-dbus.description: Activates the D-Bus session bus at X session launch if dbus is installed.

use-ssh-agent.description: Runs the X session under ssh-agent if available and not already running.

ADD_EXTRA_GROUPS.description: If non-zero, add new non-system users to EXTRA_GROUPS.

DHOME.description: Directory where new home directories are created.

DIR_MODE.description: Permission mode for home directories of non-system users.

EXTRA_GROUPS.description: Groups to which new non-system users are added.

FIRST_GID.description: First GID for dynamic assignment to non-system groups.

FIRST_SYSTEM_GID.description: First GID for dynamic assignment to system groups.

FIRST_SYSTEM_UID.description: First UID for dynamic assignment to system users.

FIRST_UID.description: First UID for dynamic assignment to non-system users.

GID_POOL.description: File or directory containing GID override records.

GROUPHOMES.description: Deprecated: if yes, create home dirs as /home/groupname/username.

LAST_GID.description: Last GID for dynamic assignment to non-system groups.

LAST_SYSTEM_GID.description: Last GID for dynamic assignment to system groups.

LAST_SYSTEM_UID.description: Last UID for dynamic assignment to system users.

LAST_UID.description: Last UID for dynamic assignment to non-system users.

LETTERHOMES.description: Deprecated: if yes, create home dirs as /home/first_letter/username.

LOGMSGLEVEL.description: Minimum priority for messages logged to syslog/journal.

NAME_REGEX.description: Regex for validating non-system usernames and group names.

QUOTAUSER.description: User from whom new users inherit disk quotas (via edquota -p).

SETGID_HOME.description: Deprecated: if yes, set set-group-ID bit on user's home dir.

SKEL.description: Skeleton directory for copying files into new home directories.

SKEL_IGNORE_REGEX.description: Regex: files in SKEL matching this pattern are not copied.

STDERRMSGLEVEL.description: Minimum priority for messages logged to stderr.

STDOUTMSGLEVEL.description: Minimum priority for messages logged to console/stdout.

SYS_DIR_MODE.description: Permission mode for home directories of system users.

SYS_NAME_REGEX.description: Regex for validating system usernames and group names.

UID_POOL.description: File or directory containing UID override records.

USERGROUPS.description: If yes, create a private group for each new non-system user.

USERS_GID.description: GID of group for new non-system users when USERGROUPS=no.

USERS_GROUP.description: Name of group for new non-system users when USERGROUPS=no.

add-service-cookie.description: Add a random cookie to all locally registered services' TXT records.

allow-interfaces.description: Set a comma separated list of allowed network interfaces.

allow-point-to-point.description: Allow use of point-to-point network interfaces.

browse-domains.description: Set a comma separated list of browsing domains.

cache-entries-max.description: Maximum number of resource records cached per interface.

check-response-ttl.description: Activate extra security check requiring incoming IP TTL be 255.

clients-max.description: Maximum number of concurrent D-Bus clients allowed.

deny-interfaces.description: Set a comma separated list of network interfaces that should be ignored.

disable-publishing.description: If yes, no records will be published; querying-only mode.

disable-user-service-publishing.description: If yes, user applications cannot publish services.

disallow-other-stacks.description: Prevent other processes from binding to UDP port 5353.

domain-name.description: Set the default domain name avahi-daemon tries to register its host name and services on the LAN in.

enable-reflector.description: Reflect mDNS requests across local interfaces.

enable-wide-area.description: Enable wide-area DNS-SD via unicast DNS.

entries-per-entry-group-max.description: Maximum number of entries (resource records) per entry group.

host-name.description: Set the host name avahi-daemon tries to register on the LAN.

host-name-from-machine-id.description: Use machine-id as name on the LAN.

objects-per-client-max.description: Maximum number of objects per D-Bus client.

publish-a-on-ipv6.description: Publish IPv4 A records via IPv6 when IPv6 is enabled.

publish-aaaa-on-ipv4.description: Publish IPv6 AAAA records via IPv4 when IPv4 is enabled.

publish-addresses.description: Register mDNS address records for all local IP addresses.

publish-dns-servers.description: List of unicast DNS servers to announce via mDNS.

publish-domain.description: Announce the locally used domain name for browsing.

publish-hinfo.description: Register HINFO records with OS and CPU info.

publish-resolv-conf-dns-servers.description: Publish DNS servers from /etc/resolv.conf in addition to publish-dns-servers.

publish-workstation.description: Register a _workstation._tcp service for LAN discovery.

ratelimit-interval-usec.description: Per-interface packet rate-limiting interval in microseconds.

reflect-filters.description: Comma-separated list of allowed service names to reflect.

reflect-ipv.description: Forward mDNS traffic between IPv4 and IPv6 when reflector is enabled.

rlimit-as.description: Value in bytes for RLIMIT_AS (virtual memory limit).

rlimit-core.description: Value in bytes for RLIMIT_CORE (core file size limit).

rlimit-data.description: Value in bytes for RLIMIT_DATA (data segment size limit).

rlimit-fsize.description: Value for RLIMIT_FSIZE (max file size limit).

rlimit-nofile.description: Value for RLIMIT_NOFILE (open file descriptors limit).

rlimit-nproc.description: Value for RLIMIT_NPROC (max number of processes).

rlimit-stack.description: Value in bytes for RLIMIT_STACK (stack size limit).

use-iff-running.description: Monitor IFF_RUNNING flag to detect network link status.

use-ipv4.description: If set to no, avahi-daemon will not use IPv4 sockets.

use-ipv6.description: If set to no, avahi-daemon will not use IPv6 sockets.

capability-list.description: Comma-separated list of capabilities (by name or number), or special keywords 'all' or 'none'; replaces the current process' inherited capabilities.

username.description: One or more whitespace-separated usernames, or the wildcard '*'.

challenge_password_otp.description: Whether the SCEP challenge password is treated as a one-time password.

digest.description: Digest algorithm used when signing CSR and self-signed certificates.

enroll_ttls.description: List of times (in seconds) before certificate expiration to attempt renewal.

key_type.description: Type of key pair generated for certificates (RSA or EC).

max_key_lifetime.description: Time period after key generation after which a new key pair should be generated (format: 1y, 2w, etc.).

max_key_use_count.description: Maximum number of certificates that may be issued using a key before generating a new key pair.

notification_destination.description: Destination for notifications: syslog priority.facility, email address, or command.

notification_method.description: Method used by certmonger to notify the administrator about certificate issues.

notify_ttls.description: List of times (in seconds) before certificate expiration to issue warnings.

nss_ca_trust.description: Trust attributes applied to CA certificates in NSS databases.

nss_other_trust.description: Trust attributes applied to non-CA certificates in NSS databases.

populate_unique_id.description: Whether to populate subjectUniqueID and issuerUniqueID in self-signed certificates.

rsa_key_size.description: Size (in bits) of RSA keys when not specified in a certificate request.

symmetric_cipher.description: Symmetric cipher used to encrypt private keys in PEM format.

validity_period.description: Validity period for self-signed certificates (format: 1y, 2w, etc.).

acquisitionport.description: Specifies the UDP source port for client requests. 0 uses a random port.

authselectmode.description: Determines the default selection policy for authenticated and unauthenticated sources.

bindacqaddress.description: Specifies the local IP address for client sockets.

bindacqdevice.description: Binds client sockets to a network interface.

clockprecision.description: Specifies the precision of the system clock in seconds.

combinelimit.description: Limits sources included in the combining algorithm by synchronization distance. 0 disables combining.

dscp.description: Sets the DSCP value for transmitted NTP packets.

dumpdir.description: Directory to save measurement history across restarts.

initstepslew.description: Corrects system clock by stepping or slewing at boot based on a threshold and list of servers. (Deprecated)

manual.description: Enables runtime support for the settime command in chronyc.

maxdistance.description: Maximum acceptable root distance for source synchronization.

maxjitter.description: Maximum allowed jitter for sources before rejection by the source selection algorithm.

maxsamples.description: Default maximum number of samples to keep per source. 0 disables the limit.

minsamples.description: Default minimum number of samples to keep per source.

minsources.description: Minimum number of selectable sources required before updating the local clock.

nocerttimecheck.description: Disables certificate activation/expiration time checks for N clock updates.

nosystemcert.description: Disables the system's default trusted CAs.

ntsdumpdir.description: Directory to save NTS cookies. Not saved by default.

ntsrefresh.description: Maximum interval between NTS-KE handshakes in seconds.

ntstrustedcerts.description: Specifies files or directories containing trusted certificates for NTS.

peer.description: Specifies a symmetric NTP peer association.

pool.description: Specifies a pool of NTP servers as a time source.

refclock.description: Specifies a hardware reference clock as a time source.

refresh.description: Interval in seconds between refreshing IP addresses of NTP sources. 0 disables periodic refresh.

reselectdist.description: Fixed distance added to non-selected sources to avoid frequent reselection.

server.description: Specifies an NTP server as a time source.

stratumweight.description: Distance added per stratum during source selection.

AllowAnyRoot.description: Controls whether TLS connections using non-CA-signed certificates are allowed.

AllowExpiredCerts.description: Controls whether TLS connections using expired certificates are allowed.

Encryption.description: Sets the encryption level for client-server connections.

GSSServiceName.description: Sets the Kerberos service name used for authentication (e.g., host, http, ipp).

SSLOptions.description: Sets advanced SSL/TLS options (AllowDH, AllowRC4, AllowSSL3, DenyCBC, DenyTLS1.0, Min/MaxTLSx.y).

ServerName.description: Sets the server address (hostname/IP[:port] or socket path) for CUPS connections.

TrustOnFirstUse.description: Controls whether new TLS certificates are trusted by default.

User.description: Sets the default username for client requests.

UserAgentTokens.description: Controls the detail level of User-Agent HTTP header information.

ValidateCerts.description: Controls whether TLS certificates must match the remote host name.

.include.description: Include another configuration file or directory.

.pragma.description: Set parsing behavior flags (e.g., abspath, dollarid, includedir).

MinProtocol.description: Minimum supported protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.2, DTLSv1.2).

abspath.description: If true, .include pathnames must be absolute.

activate.description: Whether to activate the provider; value is ignored.

alg_section.description: Name of the section containing EVP algorithm properties.

cipher.description: Cipher used by CTR-DRBG (ignored by other DRBGs).

config_diagnostics.description: Enable or disable error suppression; nonzero value enables diagnostics.

default_properties.description: Property query string for EVP default properties.

digest.description: Digest used by HASH-DRBG or HMAC-DRBG (ignored by others).

dollarid.description: If true, treat $ as literal (disable variable expansion).

dynamic_path.description: Path to load an ENGINE module.

engines.description: List of engine names mapping to their configuration sections.

fips_mode.description: Deprecated; if yes, sets default_properties = fips=yes.

includedir.description: Base directory prepended to relative .include pathnames if OPENSSL_CONF_INCLUDE is unset.

init.description: Whether to initialize the ENGINE immediately (1 = yes, 0 = no).

module.description: Path to the provider shared library.

oid_section.description: Name of the section containing OID definitions.

openssl_conf.description: Name of the section containing OpenSSL initialization configuration.

properties.description: Property query for fetching the RNG and underlying algorithms.

providers.description: List of provider names mapping to their configuration sections.

seed_properties.description: Property query for fetching the randomness source.

ssl_conf.description: Name of the section containing SSL/TLS configuration sections.

AllowResharingRemoteCUPSPrinters.description: Whether remote CUPS print queues are re-shared to the local network.

AutoClustering.description: Whether to automatically cluster remote CUPS queues with same name.

AutoShutdownTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-shutdown occurs (0 = immediate).

BrowseAllow.description: Accepts printers from specified hosts or networks (IP or CIDR notation or 'All').

BrowseDeny.description: Denies printers from specified hosts or networks (IP or CIDR notation or 'All').

BrowseFilter.description: Filters remote printers by properties (e.g., name, host, TXT record fields); supports NOT and EXACT options.

BrowseLocalProtocols.description: Protocols used to advertise local shared printers on the network.

BrowseOrder.description: Determines order of applying BrowseAllow and BrowseDeny rules.

BrowsePoll.description: Polls specific servers (host:port or just host) for available printers every 60 seconds.

BrowseProtocols.description: Protocols used for both finding remote and advertising local printers.

BrowseRemoteProtocols.description: Protocols used to find remote shared printers.

BrowseTimeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed per browsing operation (e.g., adding/removing a queue).

CacheDir.description: Directory where cups-browsed saves information about generated print queues on shutdown.

Cluster.description: Manually define printer clusters for load balancing.

CreateIPPPrinterQueues.description: Whether and how to create local queues for IPP network printers.

CreateRemoteCUPSPrinterQueues.description: Whether to create local queues for shared remote CUPS queues.

CreateRemoteRawPrinterQueues.description: Whether to create local queues for remote raw CUPS queues.

DNSSDBasedDeviceURIs.description: Whether to use DNS-SD-service-name-based device URIs (for DNS-SD-discovered printers only).

DebugLogFileSize.description: Maximum size (in KB) of debug log files; 0 = unlimited.

DebugLogging.description: Controls debug logging destination: file, stderr, or none.

DefaultOptions.description: Default options applied to all newly created queues (format: '-o' style).

DomainSocket.description: Specifies the domain socket for accessing local CUPS daemon.

FrequentNetifUpdate.description: Whether to update network interface info for each printer discovery entry.

HttpLocalTimeout.description: HTTP timeout (in seconds) for requests to local resources.

HttpMaxRetries.description: Number of retries for creating print queues when timeouts occur.

HttpRemoteTimeout.description: HTTP timeout (in seconds) for requests to remote resources.
