LoadBalancing.description: Load balancing method for clustered queues.

LocalQueueNamingIPPPrinter.description: Naming scheme for local queues of IPP network printers.

LocalQueueNamingRemoteCUPS.description: Naming scheme for local queues of remote CUPS printers.

LogDir.description: Directory where cups-browsed creates its debug log file.

NewBrowsePollQueuesShared.description: Whether newly discovered printers via BrowsePoll are shared to the local network.

NewIPPPrinterQueuesShared.description: Whether newly discovered IPP printers are shared to the local network.

NotifLeaseDuration.description: Duration (seconds) of D-BUS subscription renewal interval.

OnlyUnsupportedByCUPS.description: Whether to skip creating local queues for printers CUPS handles itself (IPP driverless).

UseCUPSGeneratedPPDs.description: Whether to use PPDs generated by CUPS for IPP printers.

AccessLog.description: Defines the access log file, stderr, or syslog destination.

CacheDir.description: Sets the directory for persistent temporary (cache) files.

ConfigFilePerm.description: Sets permissions for configuration files written by the scheduler.

CreateSelfSignedCerts.description: Controls whether self-signed certificates are auto-generated for TLS client connections.

DataDir.description: Sets the directory containing CUPS data files.

DocumentRoot.description: Sets the root directory for the CUPS web interface content.

ErrorLog.description: Defines the error log file, stderr, or syslog destination.

FatalErrors.description: Specifies which error types are fatal and cause the scheduler to exit.

FileDevice.description: Deprecated: controls use of file pseudo-devices for new printer queues.

Group.description: Sets the group used when running external programs.

LogFileGroup.description: Sets the group for log files.

LogFilePerm.description: Sets permissions for log files written by the scheduler.

PageLog.description: Defines the page log file, stderr, or syslog destination.

PassEnv.description: Passes specified environment variables to child processes.

PeerCred.description: Controls use of peer credentials for authorization over the UNIX domain socket.

Printcap.description: Deprecated: sets the filename for the local printer list.

PrintcapFormat.description: Deprecated: sets the format of the printcap file.

RemoteRoot.description: Sets the username associated with unauthenticated root-like clients.

RequestRoot.description: Sets the directory for print jobs and HTTP request data.

Sandboxing.description: Sets the sandbox security level for scheduler child processes.

ServerBin.description: Sets the directory containing backends, filters, CGI programs, etc.

ServerKeychain.description: Sets the location of TLS certificates and private keys.

ServerRoot.description: Sets the directory containing the server configuration.

SetEnv.description: Sets environment variables passed to child processes.

StateDir.description: Sets the directory for PID and local certificate files.

SyncOnClose.description: Controls whether fsync() is called after writing config/state files.

SystemGroup.description: Sets groups used for @SYSTEM group authentication.

TempDir.description: Sets the directory for short-lived temporary files.

User.description: Sets the user used when running external programs.

LogLevel.description: Verbosity of the CUPS error log.

bip.description: Bridge IP address and CIDR (e.g., 172.17.0.1/16) for the default docker0 bridge network.

bridge.description: Name of the default bridge interface (use 'none' to disable bridge networking).

containerd.description: Path to the containerd socket (typically auto-detected).

data_root.description: Root directory for Docker persistent data (images, volumes, etc.).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

default_gateway.description: IPv4 default gateway for containers on the default bridge.

default_gateway_v6.description: IPv6 default gateway for containers on the default bridge.

default_runtime.description: Name of the default container runtime to use (e.g., runc, nvidia).

exec_root.description: Root directory for exec-related temporary files.

fixed_cidr.description: IPv4 subnet for Docker-assigned container IPs when using the default bridge.

fixed_cidr_v6.description: IPv6 subnet for container allocation when IPv6 is enabled.

live_restore.description: Whether to keep containers running when the Docker daemon stops or restarts.

log_driver.description: Default logging driver for containers (e.g., json-file, syslog, journald).

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of concurrent downloads per image pull (higher = faster pulls but more network use).

max_concurrent_updates.description: Maximum number of concurrent image update operations (e.g., for Swarm updates).

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of concurrent uploads per image push.

max_containers.description: Maximum number of containers allowed to run simultaneously (0 = unlimited).

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for the default bridge network.

pidfile.description: Path to the Docker daemon PID file.

storage_driver.description: Storage driver to use for images and containers (e.g., overlay2, vfs, zfs).

userland_proxy.description: Whether to use Docker's userland proxy for port mapping (required for some edge cases).

bwlimit.description: Set I/O bandwidth limits for various operations (in KiB/s).

consent-text.description: Consent text displayed before logging in.

description.description: Datacenter description shown in the web interface.

email_from.description: Email address to send notifications from.

fencing.description: Set the fencing mode of the HA cluster.

http_proxy.description: External HTTP proxy used for downloads.

keyboard.description: Default keyboard layout for VNC server.

mac_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated MAC addresses of virtual guests.

max_workers.description: Maximal number of workers per node for actions like stopall VMs.

migration_unsecure.description: Deprecated: disable SSH tunnel encryption for migration.

next-id.description: Control the range for VMID auto-selection pool.

registered-tags.description: List of tags requiring Sys.Modify on / to set/delete.

REMOVE_HOME.description: Removes the user's home directory and mail spool.

exclude.description: Specify trailing directories to exclude during module search.

external.description: Specify external directories to be searched for modules, with kernel version regex or wildcard.

override.description: Override which version of a specific module is used, given module name, kernel version, and subdirectory.

search.description: Specify the order in which module subdirectories are processed by depmod.

authprotocol.description: Authenticate DHCP messages using specified protocol.

bootp.description: Operate as a BOOTP client only.

controlgroup.description: Set group ownership of control socket.

debug.description: Echo debug messages to stderr and syslog.

encap.description: Encapsulate sub-options inside custom defined option.

env.description: Push variable to environment for hooks.

hostname.description: Send hostname to DHCP server.

interface.description: Set interface scope for subsequent options.

logfile.description: Write logs to specified file.

msuserclass.description: Add Microsoft user class string (single only).

mudurl.description: Specify MUD URL for upstream access control.

profile.description: Set profile scope for subsequent options.

quiet.description: Suppress non-error output.

domain_name.description: Local domain name (e.g., 'lan') to append to unqualified hostnames. If not set, domain-less queries won’t be expanded.

expand_hosts.description: Whether to automatically append the local-domain to unqualified names in /etc/hosts and static-hosts entries. Maps to the `--expand-hosts` option.

ignore_hosts.description: Whether to ignore entries in /etc/hosts for DHCP (only use static_hosts). Prevents accidental overrides. Note: There is no direct `ignore_hosts` equivalent in dnsmasq. The closest is using `--dhcp-hostfile=/dev/null` to read DHCP host info from /dev/null instead of /etc/hosts. This schema maps to that behavior.

log_file.description: Log file path. Use '-' to log to stderr/syslog, or '/var/log/dnsmasq.log' for a file. Maps to `--log-facility`. If the value contains a '/', it's treated as a filename.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level (0 = quiet, 1+ = enable query logging). When >= 1, enables `log-queries`. Maps to the presence of `--log-queries` rather than a numeric value directly. Note: dnsmasq's `log-queries` doesn't take a numeric argument; setting the directive enables logging. There is no `log-level` option in dnsmasq.

minclass.description: Minimum number of required character classes (digits, uppercase, lowercase, others).

minlen.description: Minimum acceptable size for the new password (plus one if credits are not disabled).

ocredit.description: Maximum credit for other characters; if negative, minimum required other characters.

retry.description: Maximum number of password prompts before error.

ucredit.description: Maximum credit for uppercase letters; if negative, minimum required uppercase letters.

usercheck.description: Check if username appears in password (min 3-char usernames skipped); 0 disables check.

usersubstr.description: Check for substrings of length ≥ N in password; requires >3.

auto_bridge.description: Automatically create a bridge interface (e.g., virbr0) for NAT networking.

auto_bridge_name.description: Name of the auto-created bridge interface.

auto_memory_tune.description: Enable automatic memory tuning (e.g., hugepages, NUMA placement). Disable for manual control.

default_cpu_model.description: Default CPU model exposed to guests. 'host-passthrough' exposes host features for best performance.

default_dns.description: DNS server used by guest VMs when using user-mode networking.

default_tpm_backend.description: Default TPM backend: 'emulator' uses software TPM, 'passthrough' uses host hardware TPM.

default_video_model.description: Default graphics adapter for VMs. 'qxl' works well with SPICE; 'virtio' for minimal overhead.

emulator.description: Override the default QEMU emulator binary (e.g., 'qemu-system-aarch64'). Leave empty to auto-detect.

group.description: Group ownership for QEMU processes.

hotplug.description: Enable hotplug for disks and NICs. Required for dynamic resource scaling.

io_threads.description: Number of dedicated I/O worker threads. Higher values may improve I/O throughput on multi-core systems.

live_snapshot.description: Enable taking snapshots of running VMs without downtime.

log_file.description: Path to the log file when log_output is set to 'file'.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=none, 1=error, 2=info, 3=debug. Use 2 for general troubleshooting.

log_output.description: Where to send QEMU logs: 'file', 'syslog', or 'stderr'.

max_vcpus.description: Maximum virtual CPUs allowed per guest. Adjust based on host CPU topology.

memory_backing.description: Memory backing mode for VMs. 'hugepages' improves performance on large guests.

migration.description: Enable or disable VM live migration capability.

migration_address.description: IP address for incoming migration traffic. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

migration_port.description: Base port for migration traffic. Migrating VMs use sequential ports in the range.

migration_ports.description: Number of ports (starting from migration_port) reserved for concurrent migrations.

monitor_protocol.description: Protocol used for QEMU monitor communication. 'json' is recommended for automation.

monitor_stdin.description: Enable QEMU monitor on stdin. Disable to prevent accidental console access.

netns.description: Run QEMU processes in a private network namespace. Isolates network stack for security.

numa_auto_allocation.description: Automatically allocate guest memory to NUMA nodes. Disable for manual NUMA pinning.

sandbox.description: Enable seccomp sandboxing to restrict system calls. Keep enabled for security.

seccomp_sandbox.description: Enable seccomp filters to restrict system calls. Keep enabled unless troubleshooting.

shared_block.description: Allow multiple VMs to share the same block device. Requires external coordination (e.g., GFS2).

spice_listen.description: IP address on which SPICE servers listen. Similar to VNC, restrict to '127.0.0.1' for security.

spice_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for SPICE remote desktop connections.

tee.description: Enable support for Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) devices (e.g., Intel TDX).

tpm.description: Enable TPM (Trusted Platform Module) support in guests.

uefi_firmware.description: Enable UEFI firmware support (OVMF/AAVMF). Required for UEFI guests.

use_cgroups.description: Use cgroups v2 for CPU and memory resource control. Required for advanced QoS.

user.description: User account under which QEMU processes run. Use 'qemu' or a dedicated non-root user for security.

vhost_user.description: Enable vhost-user (userspace virtio backend) support for high-performance networking.

vnc_listen.description: IP address on which VNC servers listen. '127.0.0.1' restricts to local host; '0.0.0.0' allows all interfaces.

vnc_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for VNC remote desktop connections. Required for secure access.

aof_load_truncated.description: Load AOF even if it appears truncated (prevents startup failure on partial writes).

aof_use_rdb_preamble.description: Prefix AOF with RDB snapshot for faster load (recommended).

appendfsync.description: Sync policy: always, everysec, no. Trade-off between durability & performance.

appendonly.description: Enable AOF persistence (recommended over RDB alone for durability).

auto_aof_rewrite_min_size.description: Minimum AOF size required to trigger rewrite (e.g., '64mb', '128mb').

auto_aof_rewrite_percentage.description: Trigger AOF rewrite when size grows by this % over last rewrite.

bind.description: IP address(es) Redis will bind to (space-separated for multiple). Use '0.0.0.0' to bind to all interfaces (⚠️ insecure unless firewall-protection is applied).

cluster_config_file.description: Filename for cluster configuration (auto-generated, do not edit manually).

cluster_enabled.description: Enable Redis Cluster mode (requires multiple nodes).

cluster_node_timeout.description: Cluster node timeout in milliseconds before marking a node as failed.

daemonize.description: Run Redis as a background daemon (recommended for production).

dir.description: Working directory for RDB/AOF files and persistence data.

latency_monitor_threshold.description: Log events taking ≥ this many milliseconds (0 = disabled).

logfile.description: Path to log file. Use '-' to log to stderr.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logs. Options: debug, verbose, notice, warning.

masterauth.description: Password used when authenticating to a master (for replication).

maxclients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

maxmemory.description: Maximum memory Redis can use (e.g., '2gb', '512mb', '0' = unlimited). Required for eviction policies to take effect.

maxmemory_policy.description: Eviction policy when maxmemory is reached (e.g., allkeys-lru, volatile-ttl, allkeys-random).

maxmemory_samples.description: Number of samples for LRU and TTL eviction algorithms. Higher = more accuracy, more CPU.

no_appendfsync_on_rewrite.description: Defer fsync during BGSAVE/AOF rewrite (improves latency but risks data loss in crash).

notify_keyspace_events.description: Enable pub/sub for key events (e.g., 'AKE' = all events; empty = disabled).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for process management.

port.description: TCP port for non-TLS connections. Set to 0 if only using TLS.

replica_announce_ip.description: Public IP to announce to clients as this replica's address (e.g., for NAT/containers).

replica_announce_port.description: Public port to announce as this replica's port (when replica-announce-ip is set).

replicaof.description: Master node to replicate from in format 'host port'. Empty string = standalone/master.

requirepass.description: Password required for client authentication (⚠️ avoid in plaintext in production — use ACLs instead).

sentinel_master_ip.description: IP address of the master to monitor (only used in Sentinel config).

sentinel_master_name.description: Name of the master instance to monitor.

sentinel_master_port.description: Port of the master to monitor.

sentinel_mode.description: Enable Redis Sentinel mode for high availability (monitors masters/replicas).

sentinel_quorum.description: Number of Sentinels that must agree to detect a master failure.

slowlog_log_slower_than.description: Log commands taking ≥ this many microseconds (e.g., 10000 = 10ms). Set to 0 to log all commands.

slowlog_max_len.description: Maximum number of entries kept in slowlog.

tcp_backlog.description: TCP listen() backlog size (system-dependent max applies).

tcp_keepalive.description: Send TCP keepalive packets every N seconds (0 = disable).

timeout.description: Close connection after this many seconds of inactivity (0 = no timeout).

tls_auth_clients.description: Require clients to present valid certificates (mTLS) when TLS is enabled.

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for validating client certificates (optional).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format).

tls_port.description: TCP port for TLS-encrypted connections (used only if TLS is enabled).

callout-info.description: Callout information string to match; may contain one '*' wildcard.

description.description: Key description to match; may contain one '*' wildcard.

op.description: Operation type; only 'create' is currently supported.

prog.description: Program to execute; must be fully qualified path; may be prefixed with '|' for pipe mode.

type.description: Key type to match; may contain one '*' wildcard.

nameserver.description: IP address of a DNS name server to query.

options.description: Resolver option settings (comma- or space-separated list of keywords).

search.description: Domain search list for hostname lookup.

sortlist.description: IP address/netmask pairs to sort addresses returned by gethostbyname.

CacheFromLocalhost.description: Controls whether responses from localhost are cached.

DNSStubListener.description: Controls whether the DNS stub listener is enabled and for which protocol(s).

Domains.description: Space-separated list of domains, optionally prefixed with '~' for route-only domains.

LLMNR.description: Controls Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution support.

ReadEtcHosts.description: Controls whether /etc/hosts is read for local hostname resolution.

ResolveUnicastSingleLabel.description: Controls whether unicast DNS queries for single-label names are forwarded.

StaleRetentionSec.description: Time (in seconds) to retain stale DNS records beyond TTL.

acl-fallback-policy.description: Default policy if no access control provider found: true=allow all, false=deny all

allow-deletion.description: Allow remote media file deletion via UPnP

allow-upload.description: Allow uploading of media files via UPnP

debug.description: Set to true to show SQL statements (in [Database] section)

diagnostics.description: true=include BasicManagement:2 service with remote diagnostic tools

enabled.description: Enable or disable individual MPRIS/External peers (e.g., [org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.banshee])

extract-metadata.description: Set to false to skip metadata extraction for faster startup (in [MediaExport] section)

identifier-mime.description: MIME type for a pipeline (used with identifier in [GstLaunch] section)

identifier-title.description: Title for a pipeline (used with identifier in [GstLaunch] section)

interface.description: Semicolon separated list of network interfaces Rygel should listen on

ipv6.description: Set to false to disable binding to IPv6 addresses

launch-items.description: List of identifiers for pipelines to expose (in [GstLaunch] section)

log-level.description: Comma-separated DOMAIN:LEVEL pairs for per-domain log level control

media-engine.description: Name of the loadable module to use as media engine back-end

monitor-changes.description: Set to false to disable automatic detection of new files (in [MediaExport] section)

monitor-grace-timeout.description: Seconds to wait before extracting metadata from new files (in [MediaExport] section)

picture-upload-folder.description: Folder to store uploaded pictures (if allow-upload is true)

port.description: Set the listen port

share-videos.description: Enable or disable sharing of all videos from Tracker database (in [Tracker] section)

title.description: Title for an MPRIS peer device (e.g., [org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.banshee])

transcoders.description: Semicolon-separated list of active transcoders (in [GstMediaEngine] section)

uris.description: List of URIs to expose via UPnP (in [MediaExport] section)

video-upload-folder.description: Folder to store uploaded videos (if allow-upload is true)

virtual-folders.description: Set to false to disable virtual folder hierarchy (in [MediaExport] section)

compiler-directory.description: Specify an alternative directory that contains HLL to CIL compilers.

expand-check.description: Whether or not to check 'neverallow' rules during semanage command execution.

file-mode.description: Permission mode for run-time policy files.

ignore-module-cache.description: Whether or not to ignore the cache of CIL modules compiled from HLL.

ignoredirs.description: List of directories, separated by ';', to ignore when setting up users' homedirs.

module-store.description: Specify how the SELinux Management library should interact with the SELinux policy store.

optimize-policy.description: When true, optimize the kernel policy upon rebuilds.

policy-version.description: When generating the policy, set the policy version to a specific value.

root.description: Specify an alternative root path to use for the store.

target-platform.description: The target platform to generate policies for.

usepasswd.description: Whether or not to enable the use of getpwent() to obtain a list of home directories to label.

bus.description: Binds an I2C/SMBus adapter name to a bus number for stable referencing

chip.description: Selects which chips subsequent configuration statements apply to

compute.description: Defines raw-to-real-world and real-world-to-raw value conversion formulas

ignore.description: Hides a specific feature from libsensors output

allow_suspicious_udfs.description: Allows use of user-defined functions with only one symbol x() without init/deinit.

alter_algorithm.description: Implied ALGORITHM for ALTER TABLE when no clause specified.

analyze_max_length.description: Max column length (bytes) for automatic ANALYZE TABLE statistics collection.

analyze_sample_percentage.description: Percentage of rows to sample for ANALYZE TABLE statistics.

autocommit.description: If ON, queries are committed immediately.

automatic_sp_privileges.description: If ON, creator of stored routine automatically gets ALTER/EXECUTE privileges.

back_log.description: Number of outstanding connection requests allowed in listen queue.

big_tables.description: If ON, temporary tables are saved to disk instead of memory.

bind_address.description: Address(es) the server listens on for TCP/IP connections.

block_encryption_mode.description: Default block encryption mode for AES_ENCRYPT()/AES_DECRYPT().

character_set_client.description: Character set used for queries from client.

character_set_collations.description: Overrides for default collations per character set.

character_set_connection.description: Character set used for number-to-string conversion and literals without introducer.

character_set_database.description: Character set of the default database.

character_set_results.description: Character set used for results/error messages to client.

character_set_server.description: Default character set for the server.

character_set_system.description: Character set used for storing identifiers.

character_sets_dir.description: Directory where character set definitions are installed.

check_constraint_checks.description: If OFF, constraint checks are disabled (e.g., during data loading).

collation_connection.description: Collation used for the connection character set.

collation_database.description: Collation used for the default database.

collation_server.description: Default collation used by the server.

completion_type.description: Transaction completion behavior (e.g., chain or release).

concurrent_insert.description: Controls concurrent INSERT behavior for MyISAM tables.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for connect packet before aborting handshake.

core_file.description: If ON, write a core-file on crashes.

datadir.description: Directory where database files are stored.

debug.description: Debug trace options (debug builds only).

default_password_lifetime.description: Global password expiration policy in days (0 = disabled).

default_regex_flags.description: Regex flags for default PCRE behavior.

default_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for new tables.

default_table_type.description: Deprecated alias of default_storage_engine; removed in MariaDB 5.5.

div_precision_increment.description: Digits added to decimal result precision in division.

iolog_group.description: Group to set on new I/O log files/directories

iolog_mode.description: File mode for I/O log files (octal)

iolog_user.description: User to set on new I/O log files/directories

listen_address.description: Host name or IP address, optional port, and optional TLS flag for server to listen on

log_exit.description: Log event when command exits or is terminated

log_passwords.description: Include passwords in terminal I/O logs if present

log_type.description: Where to log security policy events

logfile_path.description: Path to file-based event log (must start with '/')

logfile_time_format.description: strftime format for timestamps in file-based logs

maxlen.description: Max syslog message length in bytes; longer messages are split

maxseq.description: Maximum decimal value for %{seq} escape (base-36: ZZZZZZ)

passprompt_regex.description: POSIX extended regex to match password prompts (multiple allowed)

pid_file.description: Path to the file containing the process ID of the running sudo_logsrvd

relay_dir.description: Directory for temporarily storing logs before relaying

relay_host.description: Relay host name or IP, optional port, optional TLS flag (no wildcards allowed)

relay_tcp_keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on relay connections

relay_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for relay to respond after connection succeeds; 0 disables timeout

relay_tls_cacert.description: Relay TLS CA certificate path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_cert.description: Relay TLS certificate path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_checkpeer.description: Validate relay host certificate; defaults to server value

relay_tls_ciphers_v12.description: TLS 1.2 ciphers for relay; defaults to server value

relay_tls_ciphers_v13.description: TLS 1.3 ciphers for relay; defaults to server value

relay_tls_dhparams.description: Relay TLS DH params path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_key.description: Relay TLS private key path; defaults to server value

relay_tls_verify.description: Verify server certificate used for relaying; defaults to server value

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait after a relay connection error before retrying

server_facility.description: Syslog facility for server warning messages

server_log.description: Where to log server warning and error messages

store_first.description: Store logs locally before relaying (store-and-forward mode)

tcp_keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on client connections

timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for client to respond; 0 disables timeout

tls_cacert.description: Path to certificate authority bundle for authenticating clients

tls_cert.description: Path to server's TLS certificate file

tls_checkpeer.description: Validate client certificates; clients without valid cert cannot connect if true

tls_dhparams.description: Path to custom Diffie-Hellman parameters file

tls_key.description: Path to server's private key file

tls_verify.description: Validate server's own certificate at startup

COMPRESSAFTER.description: Number of days after which daily data files are to be compressed.

DELAY_RANGE.description: Maximum random delay (in seconds) before sa2 runs; 0 means no delay.

HISTORY.description: Number of days to keep data files and reports.

REPORTS.description: Whether to generate sar report files (true) or skip report generation (false).

SADC_OPTIONS.description: Additional options passed to sadc when creating data files.

SA_DIR.description: Directory where daily data and report files are saved.

YESTERDAY.description: Whether sa2 should generate yesterday's summary (yes) or same-day summary (no).

ZIP.description: Program used to compress data and report files.

services.description: List of PAM service names the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators, and single * wildcard)

times.description: Time restrictions as logic list of day/time-range entries (e.g., Mo0900-1700, Wk1800-0800); supports ! prefix and standard day codes (Mo-Su, Wk, Wd, Al)

ttys.description: List of terminal (tty) names the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators, and single * wildcard)

users.description: List of users or netgroups the rule applies to (semicolon-separated, supports !, &, | operators and single * wildcard; netgroups disallow wildcards and operators)

conf_force_conffnew.default: unset (script asks in case of doubt)
conf_force_conffnew.description: Force overriding the installed config file

conf_force_conffold.default: unset (script asks in case of doubt)
conf_force_conffold.description: Force retaining the installed config file

conf_old_mdsum_file.description: Explicit file to read historical md5sums from

conf_source_dir.description: Directory where historical md5sums for files are looked for

children_max.description: Maximum number of events executed in parallel; 0 means auto-determined.

event_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for an event to finish before termination.

exec_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) before executing each RUN{program} rule.

resolve_names.description: When to resolve user/group names: early (on rule parsing), late (per event), or never.

timeout_signal.description: Signal sent to workers and spawned processes on timeout.

encryption.description: Sets the default encryption technology for creating encrypted filesystems.

modules.description: Controls which modules should be loaded: a comma-separated list or '*' for all modules.

modules_load_preference.description: Specifies when to load plugins: on startup or on demand via D-Bus.

backup_initramfs.description: If set to yes, keeps a .bak backup of the previous initramfs.

update_initramfs.description: Controls whether initramfs updates are performed: yes (latest only), no (disabled), or all (all known initramfs).

PRUNEFS.description: Whitespace-separated list of file system types to skip during scanning.

PRUNENAMES.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory names to skip during scanning.

PRUNEPATHS.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory paths to skip during scanning.

PRUNE_BIND_MOUNTS.description: Whether to skip bind mounts (1/yes to skip).

enabled.description: When set to False, xdg-user-dirs-update will not change the XDG user dirs configuration.

filename_encoding.description: Sets the filename encoding to use (e.g., UTF-8 or locale).

DESKTOP.description: Default path for the Desktop directory, relative to the home directory.

DOCUMENTS.description: Default path for the Documents directory, relative to the home directory.

DOWNLOAD.description: Default path for the Downloads directory, relative to the home directory.

MUSIC.description: Default path for the Music directory, relative to the home directory.

PICTURES.description: Default path for the Pictures directory, relative to the home directory.

PUBLICSHARE.description: Default path for the Public share directory, relative to the home directory.

TEMPLATES.description: Default path for the Templates directory, relative to the home directory.

VIDEOS.description: Default path for the Videos directory, relative to the home directory.

comment.description: Comment or note about this user.

enabled.description: Whether this user is enabled or disabled.

allow_ssl.description: Allow SSL/TLS but do not require it (plaintext allowed if client declines TLS).

anon_max_rate.description: Max upload rate in bytes/sec for anonymous users (0 = unlimited).

anon_root.description: Directory to serve as root for anonymous users. Must exist and be owned by 'ftp'.

anon_umask.description: Umask for anonymous uploads (e.g., '077' → files 600, dirs 700 for security).

anon_upload_dir.description: Directory for anonymous uploads. Required for anon_upload_enable to take effect. Must be writable by the 'ftp' user.

anon_upload_enable.description: Allow anonymous users to upload files. Requires write_enable and proper directory permissions.

anonymous_enable.description: Allow anonymous FTP logins. Only enable if public file sharing is needed.

ascii_mode_upload.description: Enable ASCII mode uploads (auto-convert line endings).

banner_file.description: Path to file containing banner message (overrides ftpd_banner if set).

chroot_list_enable.description: Enable chroot exception list (users listed in chroot_list_file are exempt from chrooting).

chroot_list_file.description: Path to file containing users who should *not* be chrooted (if chroot_local_user=YES).

chroot_local_user.description: Chroot local users to their home directories for security. Prevents filesystem escape.

data_connection_timeout.description: Timeout for idle data connections (in seconds).

ftpd_banner.description: Banner displayed on initial FTP connection (e.g., welcome message).

guest_enable.description: Enable virtual users (requires PAM config mapping virtual users to system users).

guest_username.description: System user to map virtual users to (must exist).

hide_ids.description: Hide local user/group names in directory listings (shows numeric IDs instead).

listen.description: Run vsftpd in standalone mode (listening directly on ports).

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to (empty = all interfaces). Leave blank unless binding to specific interface.

listen_ipv6.description: Listen on IPv6 instead of IPv4 (if listen=YES and listen_ipv6=YES).

listen_port.description: FTP control port. Standard FTP uses 21.

local_enable.description: Allow local system users to log in via FTP.

local_max_rate.description: Max upload rate in bytes/sec for local users (0 = unlimited).

local_root.description: Root directory for local users after login. Use '$USER' for per-user home-based isolation.

local_umask.description: Umask for local users' uploaded files (e.g., '022' → files 644, dirs 755).

log_file.description: Alternate log file path (used when xferlog_std_format=NO).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous clients. Set to 0 for unlimited.

max_per_ip.description: Maximum clients allowed per IP address.

pam_service_name.description: Name of PAM service for authentication (must match file in /etc/pam.d/).

pasv_enable.description: Enable passive FTP mode (required for clients behind NAT/firewalls).

pasv_max_port.description: Maximum port in the passive port range. Must be ≥ pasv_min_port. 0 = any port.

pasv_min_port.description: Minimum port in the passive port range. Ensure firewall allows this range. 0 = any port.

require_ssl.description: Require SSL/TLS for data connections (force encrypted file transfers).

rsa_private_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key (PEM format). If not set, the private key is expected to be in the same file as the certificate.

ssl_ciphers.description: Cipher suites to permit. Restrict to strong ciphers (e.g., AES-GCM, ChaCha20).

ssl_enable.description: Enable FTP over SSL/TLS (FTPS). Strongly recommended for production.

ssl_protocols.description: SSL/TLS protocols to allow. Use spaces or commas to separate. Avoid SSLv3, TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1.

syslog_enable.description: Log to syslog instead of file-based logs.

tcp_wrappers.description: Use TCP Wrappers (/etc/hosts.allow, /etc/hosts.deny) for access control.

timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

user_config_dir.description: Directory containing per-user config files (named by username).

user_sub_token.description: Token used to substitute virtual usernames in paths (e.g., /home/vsftpd/$USER).

utf8_filesystem.description: Assume filesystem uses UTF-8 encoding (helps with international filenames).

virtual_user_config_dir.description: Directory for per-virtual-user config files (used when guest_enable=YES).

write_enable.description: Allow FTP write operations (uploads, deletes, renames). Disable for read-only FTP.

xferlog_file.description: Path to the transfer log file.

xferlog_std_format.description: Use standard wu-ftpd-style log format (for compatibility with log analyzers).

dumpdir.description: Store resulting files to specified directory.

enabled.description: Enable backup fleecing.

ionice.description: Set IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler.

keep-all.description: Keep all backups. Conflicts with other options when true.

keep-daily.description: Keep backups for the last N different days.

keep-hourly.description: Keep backups for the last N different hours.

keep-monthly.description: Keep backups for the last N different months.

keep-weekly.description: Keep backups for the last N different weeks.

keep-yearly.description: Keep backups for the last N different years.

lockwait.description: Maximal time to wait for the global lock (minutes).

mailnotification.description: Deprecated: use notification targets/matchers instead. Specify when to send a notification mail.

mailto.description: Deprecated: Use notification targets/matchers instead. Comma-separated list of email addresses or users that should receive email notifications.

max-workers.description: Allow up to this many IO workers at the same time for VMs.

notes-template.description: Template string for generating notes for the backup(s).

notification-mode.description: Determine which notification system to use.

pbs-change-detection-mode.description: PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups.

pbs-entries-max.description: Limits number of entries allowed in memory for container backups to PBS.

pigz.description: Use pigz instead of gzip when N>0.

pool.description: Backup all known guest systems included in the specified pool.

protected.description: If true, mark backup(s) as protected.

prune-backups.description: Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.

remove.description: Prune older backups according to prune-backups.

stopwait.description: Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped (minutes).

storage.description: Store resulting file to this storage.

tmpdir.description: Store temporary files to specified directory.

AccelerationThreshold.description: sets velocity threshold for acceleration to take effect

AdaptiveDeceleration.description: allows deceleration at low pointer speeds

AllowByteSwappedClients.description: allows clients with different byte-order than the server

AllowMouseOpenFail.description: tells mousedrv/vmmouse not to report failure if mouse can't be opened

AllowNonLocalXvidtune.description: allows xvidtune to connect from another host

AutoAddDevices.description: enables automatic input device addition from HAL/udev

AutoAddGPU.description: enables automatic GPU device addition from udev

AutoBindGPU.description: enables automatic secondary GPU setup as output-sources

AutoEnableDevices.description: enables automatic device enabling after adding

AutoServerLayout.description: always adds the device to the ServerLayout section

BlankTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for blank phase of screensaver (minutes)

BusID.description: specifies the bus location of the graphics card

Chipset.description: specifies the chipset used on the graphics board

Clocks.description: specifies pixel clocks supported by the graphics board

ConstantDeceleration.description: multiplies pointer speed by a constant factor

DisableVidModeExtension.description: disables VidMode extension parts used by xvidtune

DisplaySize.description: specifies physical width/height of monitor in mm

DontVTSwitch.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Fn sequence for virtual terminal switching

DontZap.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Backspace to terminate X server

Floating.description: sets up device floating (no event reporting via master device)

FontPath.description: sets the search path for fonts

GlxVisuals.description: controls how many GLX visuals are set up

HTimings.description: horizontal timings for a video mode

IgnoreABI.description: allows modules built for a different X server version to load

IndirectGLX.description: enables or disables indirect GLX contexts

Load.description: loads a specified Xorg server module

MatchDriver.description: matches kernel driver name for outputs

MatchProduct.description: matches substring in device's product name

MatchSeat.description: matches seat ID from -seat server option

MatchVendor.description: matches substring in device's vendor name

MaxClients.description: sets maximum number of clients allowed to connect

MemBase.description: specifies linear frame buffer base address

ModeLine.description: compact definition for a video mode

ModulePath.description: sets the search path for loadable Xorg server modules

NoMatchProduct.description: negative match for product name substring

NoMatchTag.description: negative match for config backend tags

NoMatchVendor.description: negative match for vendor name substring

NoOutputInitialSize.description: overrides screen size when no outputs are connected

OffTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS off phase (minutes)

Position.description: specifies position of monitor (x y coordinates)

PreferCloneMode.description: prefers clone mode for monitors over horizontal extend

PreferredMode.description: specifies preferred initial video mode for monitor

Screen.description: specifies which display head this device applies to

StandbyTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS standby phase (minutes)

SuspendTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS suspend phase (minutes)

SyncOnGreen.description: drives sync signal on green color pin

TransformationMatrix.description: 3x3 transformation matrix for absolute input devices

UseDefaultFontPath.description: includes default font path even if other paths are specified

UseModes.description: includes video modes from named Modes section

VScan.description: number of times each scanline is painted

VTimings.description: vertical timings for a video mode

VideoRam.description: specifies video RAM size in kBytes

XkbDir.description: sets the base directory for keyboard layout files

ZoomModes.description: specifies modes for zoom switching via keypad

EnableProcessId.description: Includes process ID in log messages.

able_token_login.description: Requires username and password during initial connection.

background.description: Hex RGB background color for login/log window.

black.description: Hex RGB color for black (login/log window).

bulk_compression.description: Enables compression of bulk data in xrdp(8).

channel_code.description: Disables all channels if set to false.

chansrvport.description: xrdp-chansrv display or domain socket path.

cliprdr.description: Enables RDP channel for clipboard redirection.

crypt_level.description: Regulates encryption level of Standard RDP Security.

dark_blue.description: Hex RGB color for dark blue.

dark_grey.description: Hex RGB color for dark grey.

disabled_encodings_mask.description: Bitmask to disable Xvnc server encodings.

fork.description: Forks a subprocess for each connection if enabled.

hidelogwindow.description: Hides the log messages window if enabled.

ip.description: IP address of host to connect to.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file.

max_bpp.description: Maximum color depth (bits per pixel) allowed.

name.description: Display name of connection in login window.

omain_user_separator.description: Separator to append domain name to username.

pamerrortxt.description: Error text passed to PAM on authentication failure.

password.description: Password for connection (supports ask/base64).

port.description: Port to connect to (-1 for default).

rail.description: Enables RDP channel for remote applications (RAIL).

rdpdr.description: Enables RDP channel for device redirection.

require_credentials.description: Treats domain separator in username as autologon.

security_layer.description: Security method: TLS, RDP, or negotiate.

tcp_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Size of TCP receive buffer in bytes.

tcp_send_buffer_bytes.description: Size of TCP send buffer in bytes.

username.description: Username for connection (supports ask/base64).

xrdpvr.description: Enables RDP channel for XRDP video streaming.

xserverbpp.description: Color depth of backend X server (bpp).
